name: runlight-monorepo
description: Runlight: privacy friendly web analytics that lives inside your app.

scripts.test: npm run check:dashes && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test deploy/contact/server.test.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/php-assets.mts --check
